projects.title: Soliman Group – Corporate Portfolio
projects.description: Laravel bilingual portfolio with Pages CMS, dark/light mode, Microsoft Clarity, GTM, and SMTP.
projects.longDescription: Designed and developed the Soliman Group (مجموعة سليمان) corporate portfolio at https://sg.qarflow.com/ — a Laravel platform for a custom software house. projects.title: Mustaneer – Strategic Thinking Landing Page
projects.description: Bilingual conversion landing page to sell seats for a 40-hour executive training program.
projects.longDescription: Designed and built a conversion-focused landing page for Mustaneer (مُستنير), a training and business development company, to maximize seat bookings for Strategic Thinking for Growth — a 40-hour in-person program for executives, founders, and business owners. The page walks senior visitors from “what is this?” to payment or WhatsApp application: Early Bird offer (20% off), intro video, four-phase overview and outcomes, who it’s for / who it’s not, curriculum in browsable tabs with session outputs, trainer profiles, real cohort photos and testimonials, schedule with dates and venue, fees with three payment methods (online, bank transfer, Vodafone Cash), client logos, and FAQ that pre-answers objections. Includes WhatsApp apply CTAs, an application form, and brochure download in multiple places. Fully responsive (mobile-first), Arabic and English with a language switcher, SEO and Open Graph tags for clean social sharing, and structured, extendable code. Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Fawaterk payment gateway, and WhatsApp integration.

projects.title: Sunsnow – Travel Packages Platform
projects.description: Multilingual Laravel travel platform with package search, OTP auth, guest lock, and Arabic RTL admin.
projects.longDescription: Built Sunsnow (sunsnowadvisor.com) as a multilingual travel packages platform on Laravel — a premium public site for browsing and requesting trips, plus an Arabic RTL admin panel for packages, content, users, and settings. Travelers browse a packages catalog with advanced search (category → destination cascade, price range, duration, sort), while guests see blurred placeholders until they register or log in via email OTP. Authenticated users unlock package details — executive summary, day-by-day notes, hotels, activities, smart apps, gallery, and PDF download. The site supports Arabic (RTL), English, Spanish, and French, plus contact inquiries, “request a package” flows, moderated public reviews, and a configurable floating contact button. Admins manage everything from /admin: packages CRUD, Excel import/export, bulk JSON translations, categories and tags, testimonials, contact inbox, users, site settings (including GA/GTM), languages, UI translations, and database backup.
